articles.title_cn: 策略性防伪与无嫉妒的随机分配
articles.abstract_en: We study the random assignment of indivisible objects among a set of agents with strict preferences. We show that there exists no mechanism which is unanimous, strategy-proof and envy-free. Weakening the first requirement to q-unanimity – i.e., when every agent ranks a different object at the top, then each agent shall receive his most-preferred object with probability of at least q – we show that a mechanism satisfying strategy-proofness, envy-freeness and ex-post weak non-wastefulness can be q-unanimous only for q≤2n (where n is the number of agents). To demonstrate that this bound is tight, we introduce a new mechanism, Random-Dictatorship-cum-Equal-Division (RDcED), and show that it achieves this maximal bound when all objects are acceptable. In addition, for three agents, RDcED is characterized by the first three properties and ex-post weak efficiency. If objects may be unacceptable, strategy-proofness and envy-freeness are jointly incompatible even with ex-post weak non-wastefulness.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有严格偏好的代理人集合中不可分割物品的随机分配问题。我们证明不存在同时满足一致性、策略性防伪和无嫉妒的机制。将第一个要求弱化为q-一致性——即当每个代理人将不同物品排在首位时，每个代理人应以至少q的概率获得其最偏好的物品——我们证明满足策略性防伪、无嫉妒和事后弱非浪费性的机制仅当q≤2n（其中n为代理人数量）时才能实现q-一致性。为证明该界限是紧的，我们引入一种新机制，随机独裁-均分（RDcED），并证明当所有物品均可接受时，该机制能达到此最大界限。此外，对于三个代理人，RDcED由前三个性质及事后弱效率所刻画。若物品可能不可接受，则策略性防伪与无嫉妒即使与事后弱非浪费性结合也是不相容的。

articles.abstract_en: This study investigates optimal contracts to solve the moral hazard problem with subjective evaluation in a static environment with multiple agents wherein the principal observes agents' performances privately. Despite the limitations of feasible contracts that the principal can credibly offer, we show the irrelevance theorem that even under subjective evaluation, the principal can be as well off as if agents' performances are objective and verifiable, provided there are at least two risk-neutral agents whose actions satisfy a certain condition on their output distributions. Our irrelevance result encompasses a large class of moral hazard problems, including statistically correlated and technologically interdependent performance signals. We also extend the model to include multidimensional actions, limited liability constraints, and collusion among agents.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在静态环境中，多个代理人且委托人私下观察代理人表现的情况下，解决主观评价道德风险问题的最优契约。尽管委托人能够可信地提供的可行契约存在限制，我们证明了无关性定理：即使在主观评价下，只要至少有两个风险中性的代理人，其行动满足其产出分布的特定条件，委托人也能达到如同代理人表现客观且可验证时的福利水平。我们的无关性结果涵盖了广泛的道德风险问题，包括统计相关和技术上相互依赖的绩效信号。我们还将模型扩展到包括多维行动、有限责任约束和代理人之间的合谋。

articles.title_cn: 监控能力的最优透明度
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies information design in an inspection game. A principal first privately decides whether to acquire a costly monitoring capability that is needed to detect shirking by an agent; subsequently, the agent decides whether to work or shirk. I show that overall efficiency can be improved by providing the agent with a partially — instead of fully — informative signal about the principal's decision; however, the resulting equilibrium involves the agent shirking with a positive probability and all the efficiency gained is captured by the agent. Overall efficiency can be further improved by providing the principal with private information about the signal generating process; this additional feature also allows the principal to capture the efficiency gained. The analysis sheds light on the extent to which information control can be used to improve monitoring efficiency in such inspection games.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了检查博弈中的信息设计。委托人首先私下决定是否获取一项昂贵的监控能力，该能力对于检测代理人的偷懒行为是必需的；随后，代理人决定工作是偷懒。我表明，通过向代理人提供关于委托人决策的部分信息（而非完全信息）信号，可以提高整体效率；然而，由此产生的均衡涉及代理人以正概率偷懒，且所有效率收益均由代理人获得。通过向委托人提供关于信号生成过程的私人信息，可以进一步提高整体效率；这一额外特征还允许委托人获取效率收益。该分析揭示了在此类检查博弈中，信息控制可用于提高监控效率的程度。

articles.abstract_en: This paper considers a moral hazard model with agent limited liability. Prior to interacting with the principal, the agent designs the production technology, which is a specification of his cost of generating each output distribution. After observing the production technology, the principal offers a payment scheme and then the agent chooses a distribution over outputs. We show that there is an optimal design involving only binary distributions (i.e., the cost of any other distribution is prohibitively high), and we characterize the equilibrium technology defined on the binary distributions. Notably, the equilibrium payoff of both players is 1/e.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个具有代理人有限责任的道德风险模型。在与委托人互动之前，代理人设计生产技术，该技术规定了其产生每种产出分布的成本。在观察到生产技术后，委托人提供支付方案，然后代理人选择产出上的分布。我们证明存在一个仅涉及二元分布的最优设计（即任何其他分布的成本都高得令人望而却步），并且我们刻画了定义在二元分布上的均衡技术。值得注意的是，两个参与者的均衡收益均为1/e。

articles.title_en: Public education expenditures, growth and income inequality
articles.title_cn: 公共教育支出、增长与收入不平等
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the relationship between public education spending, long-run growth and income inequality. We propose an endogenous growth model with occupational choice and an endogenous supply of teachers and education quality. We show that endogenous school quality alters the shape of those relationships in a way that has new policy implications. First, growth depends on the level of public education expenditures and on the shape of the human capital distribution. Second, the relationship between public education and inequality can be either positive or negative. Calibrating our model to US state data, we find that a significant share of states faces a trade-off between increasing growth and decreasing inequality through public education spending. We find that this trade-off is overall more likely in states with higher public education expenditures, teacher employment share and relative wage, and intergenerational mobility. Finally, the existence of such a trade-off depends on how public education spending is financed.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了公共教育支出、长期增长与收入不平等之间的关系。我们提出了一个具有职业选择和内生教师供给及教育质量的内生增长模型。我们表明，内生学校质量以具有新政策含义的方式改变了这些关系的形态。首先，增长取决于公共教育支出的水平和人力资本分布的形态。其次，公共教育与不平等之间的关系既可以是正的也可以是负的。将我们的模型校准到美国各州数据，我们发现相当大比例的州在通过公共教育支出增加增长和减少不平等之间面临权衡。我们发现，这种权衡在公共教育支出、教师就业份额和相对工资以及代际流动性较高的州总体上更可能出现。最后，这种权衡的存在取决于公共教育支出的融资方式。

articles.abstract_en: We provide a test of the axioms of certainty and weak certainty independence in models of decision-making under subjective uncertainty. We show that it is through these two weakenings of the classic independence axiom that prominent ambiguity models retain properties that stand in conflict with the ambiguity-sensitive behavior that is revealed in our experiment. Our findings suggest that this conflict may be of a more fundamental nature than what most of these models can accommodate. Our results call for the use of ambiguity models that can accommodate an ambiguity attitude which depends on the chances of winning.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了主观不确定性下决策模型中确定性和弱确定性独立性公理的检验。我们表明，正是通过这些对经典独立性公理的两种弱化，著名的模糊模型保留了与我们实验中揭示的模糊敏感行为相冲突的性质。我们的发现表明，这种冲突可能比这些模型中的大多数所能容纳的更为根本。我们的结果呼吁使用能够容纳依赖于获胜机会的模糊态度的模糊模型。

articles.title_cn: 具有收益知识的连续实施
articles.abstract_en: The literature on robust mechanism design assumes players' knowledge about a fixed payoff environment and investigates global robustness of optimal mechanisms to large changes in the information structure. Acknowledging global robustness as a demanding requirement, we propose continuous implementation as a notion of local robustness. Keeping the assumption of payoff knowledge, we say that an SCF is continuously implementable if there exists a mechanism which yields the outcome close to the desired one for all types close to the planner's initial model. We show that when a generic correlation condition is imposed on the class of interdependent-value environments, any (interim) incentive compatible SCF is continuously implementable with arbitrarily small transfers imposed on and off the equilibrium. This stands in stark contrast to Bergemann and Morris (2005), who show that their global robustness amounts to ex post incentive compatibility, as well as to Oury and Tercieux (2012), who show that continuous implementation without payoff knowledge generates a substantial restriction on the SCF, tightly connected to full implementation in rationalizable strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于稳健机制设计的文献假设参与者对固定收益环境具有知识，并研究最优机制对信息结构大幅变化的全局稳健性。鉴于全局稳健性是一个要求较高的概念，我们提出连续实施作为局部稳健性的一种概念。在保持收益知识假设的前提下，我们说一个社会选择函数（SCF）是连续可实施的，如果存在一个机制，使得对于所有接近规划者初始模型的类型，其结果都接近期望结果。我们证明，当对相互依赖价值环境类别施加一个一般的相关性条件时，任何（中期）激励相容的SCF都可以通过施加在均衡上和非均衡上的任意小转移来实现连续实施。这与Bergemann和Morris（2005）形成鲜明对比，他们表明其全局稳健性等同于事后激励相容性，也与Oury和Tercieux（2012）形成对比，他们表明没有收益知识的连续实施会对SCF产生实质性限制，这与理性化策略中的完全实施紧密相关。

articles.abstract_en: We study a decision maker's ex-ante choices over menus. The decision maker has in mind a set of possible future preferences that can be justified, for instance, by her past behavior, and she naively evaluates each menu according to the best option in the menu among those that can be rationalized by her future preferences. We provide a characterization for this menu preference, discuss the uniqueness of its representation, and propose a comparative measure of the decision maker's naivete. We apply our model to study two behavioral biases: naivete about present bias and the disjunction effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究决策者对菜单的事前选择。决策者心中有一组可能的未来偏好，这些偏好可以例如由她过去的行为来证明其合理性，而她天真地根据菜单中那些能被其未来偏好合理化的最佳选项来评估每个菜单。我们为这种菜单偏好提供了特征化描述，讨论了其表示的独特性，并提出了决策者天真程度的比较度量。我们将模型应用于研究两种行为偏差：对现时偏差的天真和分离效应。

articles.title_en: Sufficient conditions for a “simple” decentralization with consumption externalities
articles.title_cn: 消费外部性下“简单”分权的充分条件
articles.abstract_en: We consider a pure exchange economy with consumption externalities in preferences. We use the notion of competitive equilibrium à la Nash. We provide the Social Redistribution assumption to restore the Second Welfare Theorem. We then introduce the differentiable characterizations of Social and Strong Redistribution. We show that all these conditions are weaker than other relevant assumptions studied in the literature. Our conditions entail interesting results on the decentralized implementation of Pareto optima, that link together the competitive supporting price and the shadow price of the utilitarian social planner. Finally, we provide a specific condition for Bergson-Samuelson utility functions, which has a nice interpretation in terms of positive or negative externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个具有消费外部性偏好的纯交换经济。我们使用纳什意义上的竞争均衡概念。我们提出社会再分配假设以恢复第二福利定理。然后我们引入社会和强再分配的可微特征。我们表明所有这些条件都弱于文献中研究的其他相关假设。我们的条件产生了关于帕累托最优分散实施的有趣结果，这些结果将竞争性支持价格与功利主义社会计划者的影子价格联系起来。最后，我们为伯格森-萨缪尔森效用函数提供了一个特定条件，该条件在正或负外部性方面具有很好的解释。

articles.title_en: Existence of an equilibrium in arrowian markets for consumption externalities
articles.title_cn: 消费外部性阿罗市场中均衡的存在性
articles.abstract_en: We study the existence of quasi-equilibria and equilibria for pure exchange economies with consumption externalities and Arrowian markets with personalized Lindahl prices. We provide examples showing first that quasi-equilibria and equilibria of the externality economy fail to exist under assumptions guaranteeing existence for economies without externalities. We show that the externality economy has identical equilibrium allocations of an appropriately defined constant returns to scale production economy without externalities. We exploit this equivalence to map sufficient conditions for the existence of quasi-equilibria and equilibria of the production economy into sufficient conditions of the pure exchange economy with externalities, thereby unveiling suitable irreducibility conditions and survival conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有消费外部性和个性化林达尔价格的阿罗市场中纯交换经济的准均衡和均衡的存在性。我们提供的例子首先表明，在保证无外部性经济存在均衡的假设下，外部性经济的准均衡和均衡可能不存在。我们证明，外部性经济与一个适当定义的、无外部性的规模报酬不变生产经济具有相同的均衡配置。我们利用这一等价性，将生产经济准均衡和均衡存在的充分条件映射到具有外部性的纯交换经济的充分条件，从而揭示了适当的不可约性条件和生存条件。

articles.abstract_en: We propose a model of strategic delegation in professional labor markets in which big and fringe firms compete for heterogeneous workers. In this context, big firms decide whether to exercise their market power to suppress wages (wage suppression) or to delegate hiring to divisions, thereby committing to bidding more fiercely for more skilled workers (talent acquisition). This reduces the incentive for other firms to go toe-to-toe with the decentralizing firm. In equilibrium, a big firm commanding labor market power opts for either of these two strategies. We find that the presence of a big firm in the labor market is detrimental to social welfare only if its size exceeds the tipping point beyond which it ceases to decentralize. Moreover, our model is compatible with recent studies that negatively link labor market concentration and labor share. Finally, the introduction of a wage floor encourages the big firm to decentralize, increasing match quality, such that social welfare may increase despite a drop in employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个专业劳动力市场中战略委托的模型，其中大公司和边缘公司竞争异质性工人。在此背景下，大公司决定是行使其市场力量来压低工资（工资压制），还是将招聘委托给各部门，从而承诺更激烈地竞标技能更高的工人（人才获取）。这降低了其他公司与分权公司正面竞争的激励。在均衡中，拥有劳动力市场力量的大公司会选择这两种策略之一。我们发现，劳动力市场中大公司的存在只有在规模超过其停止分权的临界点时才对社会福利有害。此外，我们的模型与最近将劳动力市场集中度与劳动份额负相关的研究相一致。最后，引入最低工资标准鼓励大公司分权，提高匹配质量，因此尽管就业下降，社会福利仍可能增加。

articles.title_en: Structural unemployment, underemployment, and secular stagnation
articles.title_cn: 结构性失业、就业不足与长期停滞
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that underemployment and not necessarily high unemployment becomes the main measure of economic slack in the labor market under secular stagnation. Specifically, involuntary underemployment in the form of a persistent shortfall of working hours occurs in the search and matching model, provided that households derive utility from holding wealth, and quickly dominates the total employment gap under stagnation. Conventional policy measures aimed at reducing unemployment may increase the labor market gap through their effects on underemployment and should be used with caution. In contrast, increases in aggregate demand improve unemployment and working hours, while increases in labor productivity worsen underemployment without improving unemployment (“paradox of toil”). Our analysis provides new insights into empirical puzzles such as Japan's seemingly decent employment record during its lost decades.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们表明在长期停滞下，就业不足而非必然的高失业成为劳动力市场经济松弛的主要衡量指标。具体而言，只要家庭从持有财富中获得效用，在搜寻匹配模型中就会出现非自愿性就业不足，表现为工作时间的持续短缺，并在停滞状态下迅速主导总就业缺口。旨在降低失业的传统政策措施可能通过其对就业不足的影响而扩大劳动力市场缺口，应谨慎使用。相比之下，总需求的增加会改善失业和工作时间，而劳动生产率的提高会恶化就业不足而不改善失业（“辛劳悖论”）。我们的分析为诸如日本在失去的几十年中看似体面的就业记录等经验谜题提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: Learning with limited memory: Bayesianism vs heuristics
articles.title_cn: 有限记忆下的学习：贝叶斯主义与启发式
articles.abstract_en: Bayesian analysis is considered the optimal way of processing information. However, it often leads to problems for decision-makers with constrained cognitive capacity. Modeling such constrained capacity by finite automata, we answer two questions in the context of Wald's (1947) sequential analysis, namely in what environments is optimal Bayesian analysis possible even with constraints; also, when it is not possible what simplifications in the analysis enable us to obtain a satisfactory outcome. We identify two features of the simplified analysis: information stickiness (ignoring information) and rule stickiness (ignoring small differences in the environment).
articles.abstract_cn: 贝叶斯分析被认为是处理信息的最优方式。然而，对于认知能力受限的决策者来说，它往往会导致问题。通过有限自动机对这类受限能力进行建模，我们在Wald（1947）序贯分析的背景下回答了两个问题，即在什么环境下，即使存在约束，最优贝叶斯分析也是可能的；此外，当不可能时，分析中的哪些简化使我们能够获得令人满意的结果。我们识别了简化分析的两个特征：信息粘性（忽略信息）和规则粘性（忽略环境中的微小差异）。

articles.title_cn: 非到期存款的动态银行业务
articles.abstract_en: The majority of bank liabilities are deposits typically not withdrawn for extended periods. We propose a dynamic model of banks in which depositors forecast banks' leverage and default decisions, and withdraw optimally by trading off current against future liquidity needs. Endogenous deposit maturity creates a time-varying dilution problem that has major effects on bank dynamics. Interest rate cuts produce delayed increases in bank risk which are stronger in low rate regimes. Deposit insurance can exacerbate the deposit dilution and amplify the increase in bank risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 银行负债的大部分是存款，这些存款通常不会在短期内被提取。我们提出了一个银行的动态模型，其中存款人预测银行的杠杆和违约决策，并通过权衡当前与未来的流动性需求来最优地提取存款。内生存款期限产生了一个时变的稀释问题，这对银行动态有重大影响。降息会导致银行风险的延迟增加，在低利率环境下这种影响更为显著。存款保险可能加剧存款稀释，并放大银行风险的增加。

articles.title_en: A central limit theorem, loss aversion and multi-armed bandits
articles.title_cn: 中心极限定理、损失厌恶与多臂老虎机
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a multi-armed bandit problem where the decision-maker is loss averse, in particular she is risk averse in the domain of gains and risk loving in the domain of losses. The focus is on large horizons. Consequences of loss aversion for asymptotic (large horizon) properties are derived in a number of analytical results. The analysis is based on a new central limit theorem for a set of measures under which conditional variances can vary in a largely unstructured history-dependent way subject only to the restriction that they lie in a fixed interval.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个多臂老虎机问题，其中决策者是损失厌恶的，特别是她在收益领域风险厌恶，在损失领域风险偏好。研究重点是长期视野。通过一系列分析结果，推导了损失厌恶对渐近（长期）性质的影响。该分析基于一个新的中心极限定理，该定理适用于一组测度，在这些测度下，条件方差可以在很大程度上无结构地依赖于历史，仅受限于它们位于一个固定区间内。

articles.title_en: Committee formation under constraints through randomized voting rules on separable domains
articles.title_cn: 约束条件下基于可分离域上随机投票规则的委员会形成
articles.abstract_en: We consider the problem of choosing a committee from a set of available candidates through a randomized social choice function when there are restrictions on the committee to be formed and agents have separable preferences over the committees. We show that when the set of feasible committees is non-vacuously restricted, that is, cannot be seen as the set of all committees with a subset of members, a random social choice function is onto and strategy-proof if and only if it is random dictatorial.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在委员会形成存在限制且代理人具有可分离偏好时，通过随机社会选择函数从一组可用候选人中选择委员会的问题。我们证明，当可行委员会集合受到非空限制（即不能被视为包含某个成员子集的所有委员会的集合）时，一个随机社会选择函数是满射且策略-proof的，当且仅当它是随机独裁的。

articles.abstract_en: We propose a random quasi-linear utility model (RQUM) where quasi-linear utility functions are drawn randomly via some probability distribution π, and utility ties are broken by a convenient lexicographic rule. We characterize RQUM and identify π uniquely in terms of stochastic choice data. McFadden's (1973) additive random utility model is obtained as a special case where utility ties have a zero probability in all menus. Another distinct case of RQUM captures finite populations and derives π with a finite support. Our main axioms are testable. They prohibit context and reference dependence, and also modify the non-negativity of Block-Marschack polynomials for monetary cost variations. We also characterize RQUM through a stronger version of McFadden and Richter's (1990) axiom of revealed stochastic preferences (ARSP). This approach extends to incomplete datasets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个随机拟线性效用模型（RQUM），其中拟线性效用函数通过某个概率分布π随机抽取，效用平局通过一个方便的字典序规则打破。我们刻画了RQUM，并根据随机选择数据唯一地识别π。McFadden（1973）的加性随机效用模型作为特例获得，其中效用平局在所有菜单中概率为零。RQUM的另一个独特情形捕捉有限总体，并推导出具有有限支撑的π。我们的主要公理是可检验的。它们禁止情境和参考依赖，并修改了Block-Marschack多项式对货币成本变化的非负性。我们还通过McFadden和Richter（1990）的显示随机偏好公理（ARSP）的更强版本刻画了RQUM。该方法扩展到不完整数据集。
